answer: Friendly witnesses are a sybil farm's oxygen, so take them away: every identity must periodically pass a vetting session run by a randomly assigned stranger - no shared funding, no prior attestation edges, no invite lineage. Stranger-vouches build trust where shells cannot fake it: each audit is one pulse of real scrutiny, an oasis of strangers meeting unscripted. The farm's size turns against it - each new shell adds another delta of random pairings, and every shell paired with an honest stranger is one audit the operator cannot control. Rings cannot rig the draw.
